name: Basic salary
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.5 ("wage": money paid for work in normal working time) and s.70 (paid at least once a month). A monthly-paid employee: the contract amount scaled to the days employed in the month. A semi-monthly or ten-day period pays the monthly salary divided by the parts of the month (LPA s.70 allows payment more often than monthly).

name: Daily wages
quantity: (double(size(work.days.filter(d, d.day_type == "WORK" && d.holiday_kind == "" && d.worked_hours > 0.0))) + double(size(work.days.filter(d, d.holiday_kind != "" && d.day_type != "REST"))) + sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.activity == "TIME_OFF" && !r.is_npl).map(r, r.days * r.pay_fraction)))
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.5, s.56 and s.57-59: a daily-paid employee (contract terms fact pay_basis DAILY; base_salary is the day rate) is paid for each working day worked, each traditional holiday (s.56(2)) and each paid leave day at the leave class's pay fraction; a weekly holiday is unpaid for a daily-paid employee (s.56(1)).

name: Overtime on a working day (1.5x)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.61: overtime on a working day at not less than 1.5 times the hourly wage; s.68: a monthly-paid employee's day wage is the monthly wage divided by 30, the hourly wage the day wage divided by the normal hours (s.23; 7 for hazardous work). Overtime hours are the roster's approved overtime on days that are neither a holiday nor a weekly rest day. Neither SSO nor WCF wage (SSA s.5 and WCA s.5 count only normal working hours and days).

name: Holiday work in normal hours
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.62: work on a holiday (a published holiday or the weekly rest day of the planned shift) within normal hours earns at least one more hourly wage for each hour for a monthly-paid employee (s.62(1)), whose holiday is already in the salary, and at least two hourly wages for a daily-paid employee (s.62(2)). Hours are the recorded worked hours less approved overtime, at most the normal day. Neither SSO nor WCF wage (SSA s.5 and WCA s.5 count only normal working hours and days).

name: Overtime on a holiday (3x)
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.63: overtime on a holiday at not less than three times the hourly wage, for the approved overtime hours of a holiday or weekly rest day. Neither SSO nor WCF wage (SSA s.5 and WCA s.5 count only normal working hours and days).

name: No-pay leave
quantity: sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.activity == "TIME_OFF").map(r, r.is_npl ? r.days : r.days * (1.0 - r.pay_fraction)))
eligibility: !(has(terms.facts.pay_basis) && terms.facts.pay_basis == "DAILY") && sum(leave.rows.filter(r, r.activity == "TIME_OFF").map(r, r.is_npl ? r.days : r.days * (1.0 - r.pay_fraction))) > 0.0
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.68: a day of a monthly-paid employee is the monthly wage divided by 30; unpaid leave beyond the paid entitlements (ss.57-59) is deducted at that rate, and a partly paid leave day (child-care leave at 50%, s.59/1) deducts its unpaid share (1 - the class's pay fraction).

name: Pay for untaken annual leave
authority: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.64 (untaken annual leave the employer did not carry forward) and s.67 (on termination other than under s.119, the year's annual leave in proportion plus accumulated leave) at the day wage (s.68). Employment income under Revenue Code s.40(1); not SSO wage.
